ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Era of Cultivation
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
A fragment of the Nine Heavens collides with your rimworld. Qi begins to flow, and the Era of Cultivation begins.
Spirit roots, cultivation realms, heavenly tribulations and techniques, inspired by Tale of Immortal and xianxia fiction. Playable with technology (techno-cultivation) or without it (classic cultivation).
